newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures close lower across board.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures close lower across board.

text.p: Singapore rubber futures closed lower across the board on some late local selling interests in line with weaker Japanese prices, brokers said on Wednesday.
They said prices in Tokyo and Kobe were sharply lower due to the yen's strength against the U.S. dollar and near-term oversupply trends.

"The market was rather quiet today in the morning due to lack of fresh incentives. The big boys were not around, there were no Chinese enquiries and the ring sessions were silent," a local broker said.

"The morning session was quiet and featureless but prices were marked down slightly in the afternoon on some selling interests in sympathy with lower prices in Tokyo and Kobe. Volume was moderate," another broker said.
At around 0945 GMT, October/December RSS3 fell three cents to 106.25 U.S. cents a kg.
October/December RSS1 fell 1.75 cents to 154.50 Singapore cents (US$1.08) a kg.
August TSR20 fell 1.50 cents to 140.25 Singapore cents (US$0.99) a kg.
